### [`frdc irf bvar`](@id ref-irf-bvar)

Compute Bayesian impulse response functions with credible intervals

|----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `data` | `String` | yes | — | Path to data file or handle stem (.csv, .jld2, .jls) |

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--lags` | `-p` | `Int64` | `4` | — | Lag order |
| `--shock` | `-K` | `Int64` | `1` | — | Shock variable index (1-based) |
| `--horizons` | `-H` | `Int64` | `20` | — | IRF horizon *(aliases: `--hor`)* |
| `--id` | `-i` | `String` | `cholesky` | `cholesky`, `sign`, `narrative`, `longrun`, `fastica`, `jade`, `sobi`, `dcov`, `hsic`, `cvm`, `student-t`, `mixture-normal`, `mixture-normal-asym`, `pml`, `skew-normal`, `lms`, `markov-switching`, `garch-id`, `uhlig`, `lewis-tvv`, `sv-em`, `robust-bayes` | cholesky\|sign\|narrative\|longrun\|fastica\|jade\|sobi\|dcov\|hsic\|cvm\|student-t\|mixture-normal\|mixture-normal-asym\|pml\|skew-normal\|lms\|markov-switching\|garch-id\|uhlig\|lewis-tvv\|sv-em\|robust-bayes |
| `--draws` | `-n` | `Int64` | `2000` | — | Posterior draws |
| `--sampler` | — | `String` | `direct` | `direct`, `gibbs` | direct\|gibbs |
| `--conf-level` | `-L` | `Float64` | `0.68` | — | Confidence/credible interval level in (0, 1) (default: 0.68) *(aliases: `--ci-level`, `--confidence`, `--level`, `--cl`)* |
| `--quantiles` | `-Q` | `String` | `0.16,0.5,0.84` | — | Posterior/bootstrap band quantiles in (0, 1) (default: 0.16,0.5,0.84 = 68% band) *(aliases: `--qtl`)* |
| `--config` | `-C` | `String` | `""` | — | TOML config for identification/prior *(aliases: `--cfg`)* |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Export results to file |
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | table\|csv\|json |
| `--plot-save` | `-G` | `String` | `""` | — | Save plot to HTML file *(aliases: `--ps`)* |
| `--model` | `-M` | `String` | `""` | — | Load model from a handle (.jld2 native, .jls serialized, .fmod interim, or model://; skip re-estimation) |
| `--config-json` | — | `String` | `""` | — | Zero-file JSON object string merged over --config (file < json < --set; e.g. '{"identification":{"sign_matrix":[[1,1],[-1,1]]}}') *(aliases: `--cj`)* |
| `--set` | — | `String` *(repeatable)* | `""` | — | Override config key=value; repeatable; dotted keys OK |
| `--result` | `-R` | `String` | `""` | — | Load a result handle (.jld2, .jls, .fmod, or result://; skip computation) |
| `--save-result` | `-W` | `String` | `""` | — | Save the result object to a handle (.jld2 native, .jls serialized, .fmod interim, or result://) *(aliases: `--sr`)* |
| `--note` | — | `String` | `""` | — | Optional free-form note stored in the handle header (--save-model/--save-result) |

|------|-------|-------------|
| `--plot` | `-g` | Open interactive plot in browser |

**Handles:** data kinds: `:timeseries`, `:csv`; model types: `BVARPosterior`; result types: `BayesianImpulseResponse`, `RobustBayesResult`

**Output tables:** `bayesian_irf` (Posterior-mean responses to the selected shock with credible bands (default 68%): horizon | variable | shock | value | lower | upper); `robust_bayes_bands` (Giacomini-Kitagawa robust bands for the selected shock: horizon | one lower/upper/robust_lower/robust_upper column per variable (--id robust-bayes)); `robust_bayes_diagnostics` (Empty-set probability, informativeness and credibility level (--id robust-bayes))
